blocks.text:
Arrival at Rio de Janeiro airport. Your driver meets you holding a sign with the company logo and your surnames. Transfer to the hotel.

Along the way, the city gradually comes into view: illuminated neighbourhoods between green hills and granite cliffs, palm trees, lights on the favela slopes and glimpses of water between the buildings. Through the gaps, you may see the ocean or the silhouette of Sugar Loaf.

After check-in, the rest of the day is free. You can head to the Atlantic, walk along the broad beach or explore the nearby neighbourhoods of Rio independently. In the evening, the city's relief is especially striking: dark mountains rise just behind the buildings, lights stretch along the waterfront and dense clusters of illuminated windows appear on the favela slopes. This is a relaxed first evening before 2 busy days of sightseeing.
